rules.description: A SysML part definition marked as a medical-device type maps to at most one FHIR DeviceDefinition (kind/definition, not a deployed device).
rules.notes: A type does not automatically imply a deployed device.

rules.description: A SysML part usage with an explicit deployment binding maps to at most one FHIR Device instance; different flight units get different Device identities.
rules.notes: Requires metadata.deploymentBinding; a design usage alone is not a runtime Device.

rules.description: A modeled observable metric capability maps to DeviceMetric (capability, not sampled value).
rules.notes: DeviceMetric defines capability; values become Observations at runtime.

rules.description: A modeled observable maps to exactly one Observation profile definition; runtime instances are 0..N Observations conforming to it.
rules.cardinality: 1 modeled observable -> 1 profile definition; 0..N runtime Observations
rules.notes: Constraints remain SysML; values become Observations when clinically meaningful.

rules.description: A SysML requirement constrains 0..N FHIR artifacts. The requirement itself is never a FHIR resource.
rules.notes: TraceLink only; optionally mirrored into R5 Requirements for FHIR-facing publication.

rules.description: No single FHIR resource represents a SysML port. The port maps to a generated interface-control contract listing permitted FHIR profile/message types.
rules.notes: Emits NO_DIRECT_MAPPING warning and generates an ICD contract indexed via DocumentReference.

rules.description: A behavior definition with genuinely clinical/workflow semantics maps to a definitional FHIR workflow artifact.
rules.notes: Executions become Procedure/Task/Communication at runtime, never at design time.

unitCrosswalk.description: Explicit engineering-unit to UCUM conversions. Absence of an entry is a mapping error, never a silent coercion.
